description: This file contains the implementation of the AWCContainer class, which manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, and state change notifications within a process container framework. It interacts with external components like AWCClient and AWCContainerAdministrator, and includes methods for waiting until the container is ready, starting, stopping, and handling state change notifications.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: A class that manages container lifecycle, including starting, stopping, and monitoring container state, with thread-safe mechanisms and callbacks for state changes.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID if the container is in the started state; otherwise, returns 0.

methods.name: AWCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running based on internal state variables.

methods.name: AWCContainer::WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Polls the AWC service until it reports readiness or a maximum number of attempts is reached.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waiting for confirmation of startup.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for confirmation of shutdown within a specified timeout.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles asynchronous notifications about container state changes, updating internal state accordingly.
